mobs.name: Zone-in (safe point)
mobs.note: eqemu_zone safe point. The entrance corridor runs from here toward the War Room (west, x rising).

mobs.name: Giwin Mirakon
mobs.note: Friendly: hail only (not a raid target).

mobs.name: Decorin Berik
mobs.note: War Room door guard. The event starts only when BOTH Decorins have died.

mobs.name: Decorin Grunhork
mobs.note: War Room door guard. A respawned Decorin's earlier kill no longer counts.

mobs.name: Tagrin Maldric
mobs.note: Spawns Animated Decorin Blades (3 to 5 kept up while engaged).

mobs.name: Glykus Helmir
mobs.note: Boar pen next to him: fledgling boars evolve every ~59 s while engaged.

mobs.name: Eriak
mobs.note: Named next to Tagrin Maldric (catalog spawn point).

mobs.name: Tallon Zek (south wing)
mobs.note: Standalone Tallon. Shadowsteps around x -725..-505, y -2100..-1820 every 20 s. Projection spawns where he dies.

mobs.name: Vallon Zek (north wing)
mobs.note: Standalone Vallon. At 50% he splits into five figures (one real); the real one splits again in waves.

mobs.name: Tallon Zek (event)
mobs.trigger: Spawns when BOTH Decorins are dead. Walks to the War Room council room (arrives ~319, -85) with 20 min idle allowance. On arrival 4 Hendin Shadow Masters spawn.

mobs.name: Vallon Zek (event)
mobs.trigger: Spawns with Tallon when BOTH Decorins die. Walks to the council room (~319, 110). On arrival 4 Gindan Flayers spawn; at 50% two Vallon copies (L64) spawn where he stands.

mobs.name: Council room (brothers arrive)
mobs.trigger: Where Tallon (~319, -85) and Vallon (~319, 110) stop and fight after the walk. Rallos 98/75/50% HP events also happen up here.

mobs.name: Gindan Flayers x4 (War Room adds)
mobs.trigger: Spawn when Vallon arrives at the council room (they split at 50%). Removed when Rallos reaches 50%.

mobs.name: Hendin Shadow Masters x4 (War Room adds)
mobs.trigger: Spawn when Tallon arrives at the council room. Removed when Rallos reaches 50%.

mobs.name: Rallos Zek (upstairs, War Room)
mobs.trigger: Spawns when BOTH Tallon and Vallon are dead, at the hidden #Rallos Zek placeholder (spawn2 361379). At 98/75/50% HP the script acts; at 50% he leaps into the pit.

mobs.name: Decorin Elites (x2 each wave)
mobs.trigger: While upstairs Rallos is engaged: a pair spawns after 20 s, then every 50 s at (1060, 581) and (1060, -560). They depop after 20 min.

mobs.name: Rallos Zek the Warlord (pit)
mobs.trigger: Spawns when upstairs Rallos reaches 50% HP. Leashes outside 439 < x < 940, -400 < y < 410 (or z > -250).

mobs.name: Chaos Boars (pit adds)
mobs.trigger: Two spawn at the Warlord point on every add wave while the Warlord is engaged (the wave timer runs every ~54 s).

mobs.name: Chaos Wraiths (pit adds)
mobs.trigger: Each add wave, a wraith spawns at every pit corpse point (5 points) and the corpse depops.

mobs.name: Planar Projection (Rallos)
mobs.trigger: Spawns where the Warlord dies; hail it for the Rallos flag (needs Zeks flag at 6 for the real one). Depops after 20 min.

mobs.name: Planar Projection (Vallon)
mobs.trigger: Spawns where the real Vallon (split fight) dies.

mobs.name: Vallon split figures (x5 per wave)
mobs.trigger: At 50% HP Vallon fades into 5 figures in this box (x -645..-565, y 1940..2020): one real (214317), the rest fakes (214318/214319).

mobs.name: Animated Decorin Blades (Tagrin)
mobs.trigger: Tagrin keeps 3 to 5 blades up every 6 s while engaged; they appear at these four points. The first ~10 drop Ore Shards.

mobs.name: Glykus boar pen (evolving boars)
mobs.trigger: Five fledgling boars in the pen; once Glykus is engaged they evolve every ~59 s (fledgling, enraged, fierce, greater, enchanted) and respawn if lost.

mobs.name: Boar stampede (random)
mobs.trigger: Every 40-120 min (while the Warlord is not up): "You hear the pounding of hooves", then ~30 boars and a piglet spawn at x ~1200..1210, y -300..-320 and run through the pit corridor.
